howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 会通过 Chat SDK 接入 Linear:指定团队的问题评论会触发代理自动回复,无需 @ 提及。每个问题的评论线程成为独立对话,代理以应用身份参与。
howto.when: 当指定 Linear 团队中的问题出现新评论时触发,无需 @ 提及。代理通过 webhook 接收所有评论事件并自动响应该线程。

howto.what_en: Once installed, NanoClaw connects to Linear via Chat SDK: comments on issues in the selected team trigger automatic agent replies without needing @-mentions. Each issue's comment thread becomes its own conversation, and the agent posts under an app identity.
howto.when_en: Triggers on every new comment on issues in the configured Linear team, no @-mention required. The agent receives comment events via webhook and automatically replies in the thread.

say_en.text: How do I reproduce this bug?
say_en.note: The agent replies in the comment thread.

say_en.note: Commenting triggers the agent, no @-mention needed.
The agent joins the discussion automatically.
